## Packages 


A **package** is a collection of code and functions that other R users publish online. 
This course focuses on packages in the [tidyverse](https://www.tidyverse.org) 


* Access the functions from a package
```r
# Load a package in the current R session or program
library(tidyverse)
```

* Download a new package, if needed
```r
# Install a package on your computer
install.packages("tidyverse")
```
